findings.text: The company was incorporated on 9 September 2024 and is recorded as active with a proposal to be struck off.
The accounts are overdue, with the next accounts due 9 June 2026 and the last made-up date not recorded.
The confirmation statement is overdue, with the next statement due 22 September 2026 and the last one made up to 8 September 2025.
The company has one current officer, a director, PERSON 363, appointed on 9 September 2024.
One person with significant control is recorded, PERSON 364, an individual holding 75 to 100 percent of shares.
No charges are registered against the company and no insolvency record is held for it.
No other company appointments were found for the director, PERSON 363, though this check may be incomplete because appointments are matched by officer ID.
No registered office address changes and no officer appointments or resignations have been filed since 24 October 2025.
